title: Towards Reconstructing Geographically Diverse Architecture with 3D Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Internet-scale photo collections of real-world landmarks have driven progress in 3D computer vision yet remain highly challenging for modern 3D foundation models (3DFMs) that estimate scene structure in a single feed-forward pass. In this work, we introduce ArchWorld, a benchmark of 3D architectural landmarks with high geographic coverage and rich metadata. We use this benchmark to conduct a thorough error analysis of current 3DFMs to understand where they fall short and how they can be improved. We examine socially relevant disparities in model error and find that model performance varies by geographic region; however, unlike typical fairness regimes, the trends only partially match training data representation. translated_title: 基于三维基础模型重建地理多样化的建筑
translated_abstract: 互联网规模的真实世界地标照片集推动了三维计算机视觉的进步，但对于在单次前向传递中估计场景结构的现代三维基础模型（3DFMs）而言，这些照片集仍然极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了ArchWorld，一个具有高地理覆盖率和丰富元数据的三维建筑地标基准数据集。我们利用该基准对当前的三维基础模型进行了深入的误差分析，以了解它们在哪些方面存在不足以及如何改进。我们考察了模型误差中与社会相关的差异，发现模型性能因地理区域而异；然而，与典型的公平性研究不同，这些趋势仅部分符合训练数据的代表性分布。我们的调查揭示，观察到的地理差异不仅反映了数据代表性和场景规模的不同，还反映了区域特有建筑特征和背景干扰因素的差异。
tldr: 该论文提出了高地理覆盖率的三维建筑地标基准ArchWorld，并通过误差分析发现三维基础模型的性能存在地理差异，其成因不仅包括训练数据代表性差异，还包括场景规模、区域特有建筑特征和背景干扰因素的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ArchWorld, a geographically diverse benchmark of 3D architectural landmarks, revealing that geographic performance disparities in 3D foundation models stem not only from training data representation but also from scene size, region-specific architectural features, and background distractors.
